# Link audit

- Check links in changed system-design sections.
- Prefer canonical documentation papers or project pages.
- Detect duplicate destinations and redundant references.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete material.
- Preserve historical references only when their role is explicit.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
